dedupe_keys.name: nwrma sierra leone hydrometric records rainfall river flow and level groundwater level

description: The National Water Resources Management Agency of Sierra Leone publishes hydrometric records on its data pages. The rainfall page holds consolidated records for 38 stations from 1941 to 1960, historic records from 1921 to 1978 for sites such as Kabala, Teko and Bumbuna, and the Rokel-Seli Water Security Project rainfall from 2012. The surface water page holds historic river stage and flow data for the major rivers and short records from commercial sites. The data overview explains that most collection stopped during the war and restarted around 2010, and that the Water Security Project began groundwater level monitoring in 2012; metadata files list each monitoring site. Coverage is Sierra Leone, with most recent sites in the Rokel-Seli basin. Access is free by download links on the pages. Caveats: there is no national groundwater monitoring network, the records are patchy, and the file formats were not opened. Simulation uses: long rainfall and river flow series for water supply, hydropower and flood studies in a data-poor country. Related records: national water point inventories on HDX (data-hdx-national-water-point-inventories).
